title: Co-Founder & Main Full-Stack Engineer
description:
L'Ingénu is a collaborative information and expression media. It aims to present news in a modular way, making it more presentable for the user. I implemented and was in charge of the whole technical stack:

  • Building an online media platform with the implicated constraints
  • Choosing an architecture that meets business needs
  • Normalizing design system rules based on mockups
